Otherwise, the watch ends after the first result.
Which changes would you like to follow?
Fictional example: announcements and date changes.
Limited scope: this scenario only covers announcements from the fictional source shown. Other sources are excluded.
Demo settings · interval: %1$d h · capacity: %2$d. No real automatic processing.
No source found in this scenario. This does not mean the request is impossible.
The initial state is a baseline: it does not trigger a new alert.
No email address is required. This fictional account disappears when the app process stops. You will then confirm the proposal.
This request is unsupported in this scenario
This scenario simulates unavailable private access. No watch is activated. You can reword your request or choose another scenario.
Demo reset. Your local draft is still available; no previous watch has been reactivated.
The draft could not be read or saved. It may be lost when closing. Try again before leaving.
Your watches will appear here after confirmation.
No notifications are sent in this demonstration.
Resuming sets a new baseline without sending missed alerts from the pause.
The watch and its fictional results will be removed after the simulated service confirms.
This content is no longer available. It may have been deleted or the demo may have reset.
Synthetic result for testing the flow. No real announcement was detected.
Criterion from the plan that produced this result
This result belongs to an earlier version of the criteria.
Refresh failed. The displayed content may be outdated. Try again.
Connection unavailable in this scenario. Choose another scenario and try again.
Response not confirmed. Try again: the same command will be reused to prevent duplicates.
A demo account is required to confirm. Return to the proposal.
This content is unavailable to this account. Return to the list.
The proposal expired. Edit your request to start a new preview.
The state changed. Review the displayed information before confirming again.
The command no longer matches this action. Check the state and start again.
Demo capacity has been reached. No new watch was activated. Free a slot or change the scenario.
This action is unavailable in this state. Return to the watch details.
Operation still pending. Refresh to check its status; no new activation is started.
Pilot limited to text changes on one public page. Write: Notify me of any change on https://… The proposal explains coverage before activation. General requests remain in preparation.
Your address receives sign-in codes. Alerts will use phone notifications.
If the address can be used, a code has been sent. It expires after 10 minutes.
Watch paused; remote service is stopping. Remote costs are not yet confirmed stopped.
Results remain available when notifications are disabled.
This closes access and requests erasure and remote shutdown. An email code sign-in within the last five minutes is required.
Account access closed. Erasure and remote shutdown are pending; completion is not yet confirmed.
This finding corrects an earlier result.
Analysis is still pending. Try again to check the same analysis; a second analysis will not be started.
Sign in to see your watches.
After confirmation, we’ll look for suitable sources. You can leave the app: a notification will tell you whether your watch is ready.
Limited trial: public sources, daily checks and partial coverage. Preparation may fail; your criteria won’t be changed without your agreement.
We’re finding sources to monitor. You can close the app; we’ll let you know when your watch is ready.
Preparation encountered a technical problem. Monitoring is inactive. Try later or edit your request.
Open your watch to see its status and sources.
The sources read cannot verify your request. Monitoring is inactive. You can edit your request.
The trial limit has been reached. Monitoring has not started.
Sources checked during preparation. Future checks may find other sources.
The service could not complete this action.
